assets.provenance: Actual capture of PanCode 0.9.0-dev, packed from branch site/v080-sprint at 0d1f36358 ahead of the release and installed with npm install -g, on 2026-11-12. Recorded by site/capture/run.mjs (scenario still-tui-boot) in a fresh bubblewrap profile (home /home/researcher, host lab) with its own network namespace, interface.demo on and interface.outputDetail set to detailed. Fixed 120x44 terminal recorded as asciinema v2 and rendered by the site's player in IBM Plex Mono at 2x. Qwen 3.8 27B through a LiteLLM gateway, reached through the capture harness's alias proxy, so the model id shows no host name. Fresh launch in ~/projects/calibration-lab, no prompt sent. Welcome panel, composer and footer (rows 3-24).

Rendered by agg from site/assets/casts/anim-fix-a-test.cast, recorded from PanCode 0.9.0-dev by site/capture/animation.mjs.
assets.role: Fix a test
assets.altTextSeed: Fullscreen terminal recording of PanCode on gpt-6-luna: the question why the absolute-zero test fails is typed into the composer and sent with a request to fix it and run the test check; Panos searches the project, finds kelvinToCelsius, edits one line of temperature.mjs, runs the test check with exit 0, and explains that kelvin <= 0 rejected exactly 0 K and that all 7 tests passed, in 9.1s.

assets.provenance: Rendered by agg from site/assets/casts/anim-model-switch.cast, recorded from PanCode 0.9.0-dev by site/capture/animation.mjs.
assets.role: Switch models
assets.altTextSeed: Fullscreen terminal recording of the /model picker in PanCode on GitHub Copilot: the session starts on gpt-6-luna, the picker lists 26 models on the copilot target, and claude-sonnet-5.5 and gemini-4-argon are chosen in turn by typing part of the name, each changing the status bar's model and context size, before the session returns to gpt-6-luna.
